speak.title: Role-play: should I try a one-match dating service?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the friend who is tired of dating apps
a.text: You have used dating apps for months and feel worn out. Your friend suggests a service that gives you one match at a time. You are curious but worried about privacy. Ask questions before you decide.

b.text: You read about a service that introduces just one person at a time. You think it could make dating less tiring. Persuade your friend to try it and answer their worries.

phrases: I'm tired of scrolling through hundreds of profiles.
What if it picks someone I don't like?
Who'll be able to see my information?
It couldn't hurt to try it for a month.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did your friend decide to try the service, and why?
